en: A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing several landmarks of a Central European city: a fountain in a busy square, grand historic civic buildings with domes and towers, a hillside hotel or sanatorium surrounded by forest, and stone ruins framed by an arch. The front bears decorative script text in the upper left. The reverse has printed text on the left, a handwritten Hungarian message in blue ink diagonally across the center, pre‑printed address lines on the right, and a green Hungarian postage stamp canceled with a circular postmark.
